sections.title: Life cycle and range
sections.text: An annual or biennial native from southern and eastern Europe through the Mediterranean to the western Himalaya, and naturalized elsewhere. It reaches about 60 cm and sometimes 1 m.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: The cream, white or yellow flowers are about 2.5–4 cm across and have a purple centre. The inflated calyx encloses a globose, hairy capsule 10–14 mm long.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: The botanical sources consulted do not confirm reliable food use.
